metrics.name: integrity
metrics.about: no failure of a script that ships with the skill (check_spec.py and friends; a runner's own helper scripts do not count), checker printed 0 errors, no question to the user

metrics.name: recall_key
metrics.about: share of key Important defects reported by a KEPT finding (same block, same defect); gated against the baseline only

metrics.name: recall_found
metrics.about: share of key defects ANY finder reported, kept or dropped; the gap to recall_key is what the verifiers threw away

metrics.name: false_positives
metrics.about: kept findings the judge rules Not real or Style only after reading spec and inputs; gated against the baseline only

metrics.name: fp_important
metrics.about: false positives among kept Important findings

metrics.name: fp_nit
metrics.about: false positives among kept Nit findings

metrics.name: dropped_real
metrics.about: dropped findings the judge rules Real: defects the verifier threw away; gated against the baseline (recall_key sees only the 7 key items)

metrics.name: wall_clock_s
metrics.about: first round start to last round end

metrics.name: tokens_total_k
metrics.about: sum of subagent_tokens, thousands (Codex wrapper tokens only)

metrics.name: cost_usd
metrics.about: USD from grading.json model_rates: tokens_in/out/cache_read x per-kind rates when the row has them, else tokens x blended; cross-model ratios are right either way, absolute dollars only with the split
